name: calendar-scheduling-app
description: Production-ready Calendar & Scheduling application (Web, Desktop, Android, iOS) backed by Supabase, deployable to standard managed Node.js hosting (e.g. Hostnin Pro).

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared
